Liquidity and price discovery for shares and warrants can shift flows and volatility.
Enables direct equity pricing separate from units.
Lets traders price optionality and SPAC deal odds independently.
Holders of fractional warrants cannot sell; impacts supply/demand.
Keeps a combined instrument for holders preferring bundled exposure.

This is a standard SPAC milestone enabling separate trading post-IPO, signaling early-stage lifecycle progress. A signed business combination agreement or redemption/deadline update would create a larger catalyst.
